primary_interest.quote: you want to build a voice AI support agent for policyholders.

use_case.quote: We want voice agents to handle the first line: status checks, document requests, basic changes.

inference_framing.quote: I'm only asking about inference because the voice agent needs it to work, not because we want it separately.

inference_raised_by.quote: First, the language model behind the agent. We don't want to be locked to one.

competitors_inference.quote: we're also looking at Baseten for the model hosting piece.

competitors_voice.quote: Twilio mostly. We've also tested Plivo for some outbound stuff.

decision_criteria.quote: We want to swap between several open models, Mistral Large and Mixtral 8x22B for now, and test which works best per agent. Second, cost, per-minute and per-token, and the total. Third, support.

stated_reason.quote: About $0.7 per million tokens. Your preliminary number was around $0.91. Our volume would be about 1500M tokens a month, so that gap isn't nothing.
